proposals: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board should publish a geocoded list of CNG outlets tagged by station type — mother, online, daughter or daughter-booster, so that a cold-chain operator can tell which nearby outlets offer continuous compression rather than cascade-dependent supply.

The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas should publish, under SATAT, which retail outlets receive compressed biogas and from which plant, so that the biogas-fed outlets this map can only suggest are identifiable site by site.

The National Horticulture Board should publish a geocoded, district-wise register of cold-storage facilities with capacity and power source, so that the cold-storage layer of maps like this one can be cited to a single official dataset rather than assembled without attribution.

The National Horticulture Board and the Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board should jointly publish a district-level overlay of cold-storage capacity and gas-connected fuel outlets, so that the co-location question this map raises can be answered from official data before any district plans gas-based backup power or reefer fuelling.
